_comment: The projects that owe a monthly QSR. Only these are checked.
name         must match the Vyaguta project name (case/whitespace insensitive).
id           optional but preferred — exact match, survives renames.
ownerEmail       optional — defaults to the project's projectLeader in Vyaguta.
inProduction     optional — informational only; Vyaguta does not record this.
requiredSections optional — array of ['Engineering', 'Code Quality', 'QA']. Defaults to all three.
skip             optional — exclude without deleting the entry.
